arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Travelers claims the lower court rule exists outside the Bankruptcy Code.
Pacific Gas and Electric asserts state law provides for these fees.
Justice Kennedy asked about standard promissory notes in bankruptcy.
Justice Roberts asked if lawyers routinely recover fees in insolvency.
